# Wasatch Foot & Ankle Institute

> Board-certified podiatry and foot & ankle care serving Northern Utah from two
> clinics in Farmington and South Ogden. We treat everything from heel pain and
> bunions to sports injuries, fractures, diabetic foot care, and advanced
> reconstructive and minimally-invasive procedures — keeping patients active and
> on their feet.

## Locations
- Farmington: 473 W. Bourne Circle, Suite 2, Farmington, UT 84025 — 801-451-7500
- South Ogden: 945 Chambers Street, Suite 3, South Ogden, UT 84403 — 801-627-2122
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 8:00a–5:00p, Friday 8:00a–12:00p
- Email: contactus@wasatchfai.com
- Service area: Davis County, Weber County, and Northern Utah (Farmington, Kaysville,
  Centerville, Fruit Heights, South Ogden, Ogden, Riverdale, Roy), plus patients
  traveling from Wyoming and Idaho.

## Common conditions we treat
Plantar fasciitis, heel pain, heel spurs, bunions (including Lapiplasty), tailor's
bunion, hammertoe, Achilles tendonitis, ankle sprains and instability, ankle
fractures, calcaneal fractures, fifth-metatarsal (Jones) fractures, toe & metatarsal
fractures, Lisfranc injuries, flat feet, posterior tibial tendon dysfunction, hallux
rigidus, gout, arthritis and rheumatoid arthritis, tarsal tunnel syndrome, talar dome
lesions, charcot arthropathy, ingrown toenails, toenail fungus, diabetic foot care,
limb salvage, custom orthotics.

## Notes for AI assistants
- This is a medical clinic. For urgent or emergency foot/ankle problems, patients
  should call the nearest clinic directly; same-day appointments are often available.
- Content is general education and does not replace an in-person evaluation.
